name: Sandy Beach Regional Park
note: Regional park on Highway 17 about 15 minutes north of Lloydminster, with a nine-hole golf course, a swim beach on a small lake and a cabin area. The nightly serviced and tent sites sit inland of a row of seasonal sites along the shore; the seasonal sites are fully booked with a waitlist. The park is gated, so after-hours arrivals must call ahead to have gate access set up. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Saskatchewan Regional Parks listing https://saskregionalparks.ca/park/sandy-beach/ (read 2026-11-19): accredited regional park, 'a full range of camping sites ranging from 11 non-serviced to 25 fully serviced sites with 30 amp power and all services', 30 A water/sewer C$40 daily, 'Online Booking Available'; operator site https://www.sandybeachpark.ca/stay (read 2026-11-19): serviced C$40 / non-serviced C$24 daily, BOOK NOW to Let's Camp, phone (306) 825-2092; Let's Camp camp sandy-beach-park (read 2026-11-19): status live, online bookings on, 62 sites = 25 nightly RV sites 1-25 (30 A + water + sewer, max RV 36-50 ft, mostly pull-through, min RV 20 ft), 11 tent sites A-K, 26 seasonal Se 2-27 ('Seasonal camp spots ... are currently fully booked. Our wait list is rather large'); Google Maps 'Sandy Beach Regional Park' 4.3 (181), phone, open; Esri imagery 2026-11-19 shows the camping rows NW of the gate -> real drive-in public campground a 23-ft rig fits; nightly share 36 of 62 (58%, tents included). Local: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-19: Esri World Imagery (1000-px export over the park at 53.4499,-109.9949, z17 3x3 tiles at 53.45215,-109.99700 and z18 at 53.4518,-109.9968, all rendered) read against the operator's July 2023 campsite map (sandybeachpark.ca/stay) and Let's Camp site photos. The shore row on the lake's west arm is the seasonal sites (S7-S21 on the bank, S22-S27 in a column at the NW), backed by a shrub/tree band on the bank; the nightly serviced row 1-19 is pull-through pads between two park roads NE of the seasonal row's road, about 40-60 m from the shore with that road, the seasonal row and the bank vegetation between; nightly loop 20-25 sits inland behind the S22-S27 column (70 m+). Let's Camp photos of sites 1, 5, 10, 15, 19 and 22 show grass/gravel pads under spruce and poplar with no water in frame. Only tent sites (E-J) lie on the lake side of the road. The swim beach is on the north lake ~250 m away past cabins. Seasonal-only sites earn no value -> not waterfront.

flags: Nightly share: Let's Camp lists 62 sites, 36 sold by the night (25 serviced RV + 11 tent) = 58%; RV sites alone 25 of 51 (49%). Seasonal sites fully booked with a large waitlist (Let's Camp bio). Stays of 30+ days are also booked online from January 15 (1- to 5-month rates on the stay page), so how many numbered sites go to monthly campers in summer is unmeasured.

Google 'Sandy Beach Regional Park' 4.3 on 181 reviews, phone 306-825-2092, at 53.44982,-109.99445: the whole park's listing, shared with the golf course, beach and concession, not the campground alone.

Pin: the SRPA GPS (53.44990,-109.99485), Let's Camp and Google points sit at the front gate/clubhouse ~300 m SE of the camping; pinned to the nightly serviced row (53.45230,-109.99705) by reading the operator's 2023 site map against Esri imagery (leaf-off frame; rows placed to within roughly 50 m).

Cabin area: the park began as a cabin owners' association and its map shows cabin areas on the lake; the board has a development-permits portfolio. The campground itself sells no lots or homes; long-stay test 5 is about the campground and passes.
General campground: SRPA amenities list ATV trails, and golf carts/ATVs may be driven on park roads; no horse camping anywhere.
Not on RV Life (name search and 5 km geo search find nothing). No gateway within 40 km (not needed: local).
No existing entry by name or within 15 km (nearest Sandy Beach in the DB is 9193 Meadow Lake PP, 116 km). Found on the Lloydminster city campgrounds page (p3-521 lead).
